definition: Number of recorded interactions for the student before the current interaction.
calculation: Sort by user_id and order_id; within each user_id assign a zero-based cumulative row count.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding rows and is leakage-safe when ordering is preserved. Measures platform experience rather than skill-specific proficiency.

definition: Mean number of the student's prior interactions across the Skill_* indicators active on the current row.
calculation: For each user_id and Skill_* column compute cumulative appearances excluding the current row; select active skills on the current row and take their mean.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding rows. For a single-skill row this is the exact prior count for that skill; for a multi-skill row it averages the active-skill counts.

definition: Indicates that the student has no prior interaction with any Skill_* indicator active on the current row.
leakage_and_modeling_notes: Uses only preceding rows. On a multi-skill row this equals 1 only when all active skills are new to the student.
